name: Customer API failures
ownerWords: do we have api portal staging? your job is PM for api portal
goal: Real customers' calls on api.virev.ai do not fail for causes on our side. The 5xx answers of the last full UTC day stay at most 1% of every answered call by the orgs PostHog marks is_internal = 0. This keeps board goal p80 met: about 31% of customer calls failed from 10-13 to 10-26, and p80's fixes (crawler 403 and 404 verdicts, the portal passing a 403, a 404 and an Instagram 429 through, the empty-account user_feed page in 9b2c02d7f) brought the day to 0.67% on 10-31 and 0.32% on 11-01. source_errors holds the read itself, because PostHog missed 03:48 to 06:19Z on 11-01 while prod Vent was down. slow_route_p90_s keeps board goal p111 met (owner 10-30: "이거 왜 20초 30초나 걸리냐"): the slowest p90 duration of the day's calls by every org, internal ones included, to /v1/search/bing, /v1/crawl/google/play-app and /v1/crawl/google/news stays at most 5 s, from the same PostHog events, and a route with under 20 calls that day reads unknown (999999). It counts internal orgs because no is_internal = 0 org called these routes from 10-20 to 11-02 and the owner's own calls come from internal orgs.

onMiss: Read the flagged customer_5xx slices: each names the operation, status, error code, handle and request id. Match each 5xx to its prod crawler span with one small ops/bin/ch-ro prod query (otel.otel_traces, SpanKind='Server', ParentSpanId='', production, an hours window, SETTINGS max_threads=2 and a log_comment), as ~/work/portal-customer-failures/q-*.sql does, and read the handle again through api.virev.ai with a billingProbe test key minted through prod Convex /api/test/seed and revoked after. Group the 5xx by cause. A cause on our side (crawler verdict, portal mapping, docs or error text) gets one fix job unless one is live; it lands with a test on dev/sieun, crawler fixes reach prod through the crawler ops train and portal fixes through the release owner's promote (c154). Count a deploy hole or a host move as its own cause and name it. A source_errors miss fixes the PostHog read; a long stretch with no api_request event in the day line means PostHog missed events, so read Vercel's auto-sns-api request logs for that stretch (vercel logs --project auto-sns-api --environment production --json). No customer email goes out without the owner's ok (c37). A slow_route_p90_s miss: read the slow_routes line. A measured route over 5 s gets one fix job on its slowest calls unless one is live; at 999999 the line names which route had under 20 calls that day. All on target: end the turn with no message.
